outcome: Use the Intel Mac mini as a bounded second exact-version Blender machine with usable slot spillover, a real Akinza comparison and an auto-merge PR.
authorizedScope: Install free compute tools and scripts, preserve CI and WSL configuration and all other worktrees, write and publish only the new worktree; no purchases, passwords or CI registration.

criteria.expectation: Exact official Linux x64 Blender 5.2.2 runs on Intel mini with unchanged CI and WSL configuration.
criteria.assessment: Matching Blender binary SHA-256 bafec183e960819c76fe213c000cdb2284c53a87ef6791812f8728b51f07145b on both machines; shimmed denoised cube succeeds.

criteria.expectation: Bound remote compute, serialize it and yield to CI; clean only after work stops.
criteria.assessment: Resource caps and CI priority verified; real final-image denoised cube, CI pause/resume, intentional failure, cancellation and cleanup pass. No remaining job folders or containers.

criteria.expectation: Selective manifest transfers with explicit PC/WSL mapping and usable local-slot spillover.
criteria.assessment: Real small local and auto spillover jobs return matching build. Case aliases, traversal, collision and cancellation tests pass.

criteria.expectation: Complete the same real current Akinza fur render on both machines and inspect pixel difference, timing and peak remote RSS.
criteria.assessment: Independent decoded RGB comparison found zero differing pixels at768x1024. Mini915.20s wall/426.3s render/2.33GiB peak versus PC179.03s/25.4s. Measured/final image provenance confirms only unrelated user-signal forwarding changed; final cube and lifecycle checks pass.

criteria.expectation: Document results, commit explicit paths, push, open PR and enable auto merge.
criteria.assessment: Implementation committed with explicit staged paths and pushed. PR814 opened with full description. gh pr merge814 --auto --merge succeeded and GitHub confirms MERGE auto merge enabled; CI still running, no merged claim.

findings.observation: Windows case aliases could overwrite input files.
findings.resolution: Casefolded overlap checks and declared file/directory spelling normalization reject collisions and support Linux transfers.

findings.observation: Remote cancellation could delete an active mount.
findings.resolution: Client EOF watchdog, cancel marker and supervisor lifetime flock await termination; daemon errors retain data.

findings.observation: Local slot could release while WSL Blender lived.
findings.resolution: Local worker kills and reaps its process tree on pipe EOF, and the slot owner awaits worker exit.

findings.observation: Pause could fail during container startup or completion.
findings.resolution: Wait for running status and tolerate completed-process removal races; live pause/resume succeeded.
Structured error archive returns logs and result before cleanup.

findings.observation: Failed unpause or removal could hang the global lock.
findings.resolution: Bound Docker control calls and process waits, check unpause/removal and reject orphan containers.

findings.observation: Host VM vCPU XPC process retained default niceness.
findings.resolution: Disk-holder identification applies nice15 only to compute VM processes. CI VZ worker remains nice0.

findings.observation: Windows host resources could admit an unsafe second WSL render.
findings.resolution: Query WSL available memory and load before existing slot capacity calculation. WSL settings unchanged.

findings.observation: Nonblocking SSH stdin EAGAIN could kill heartbeat thread.
findings.resolution: Retry EAGAIN; regression test verifies later EOF cancels correctly.

findings.observation: VZ lacks RDTSCP and the unmodified Cycles timer crashed. A narrowly reviewed compatibility shim fixes the cube, but full fur result is not verified.
findings.resolution: RDTSCP compatibility implementation passed instruction/register and negative-signal tests, final installed-image denoised cube and lifecycle checks. Full fur render completed below the cap with zero decoded pixel difference from PC. Independent review accepted proportionate validation of isolated later user-signal forwarding.

findings.observation: Results are not published in a PR yet.
findings.resolution: Pushed isolated branch, created PR814 and enabled MERGE auto merge. Required checks are running, consistent with the requested auto-merge handoff.

audit.reviewer: Codex primary plus scoped independent adversarial reviewer
audit.comparison: Every requested deliverable checked against the brief: exact official binary, bounded extra compute, CI yielding, selective PC/WSL transfers, usable manifest spillover, cleanup, real fur comparison, operating guide, pushed PR and auto merge. Independent reviewer verified identical decoded images and no substantive code defects.
audit.regressions: 19 WSL tests and 12 macOS supervisor tests pass; final installed image passed denoised cube, real pause/resume and intentional failure cleanup. Independent reviewer confirmed decoded image equality and no further substantive code defects.
audit.scopeCheck: Preserved the complete authorized outcome without modifying CI/WSL configuration, reference source or other sessions worktrees. Shared slot owner adoption is documented as explicitly permitted. No purchases, passwords or new CI runner registration.
